doc.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Joining Basie and life on the bus
title: Out of work, then Basie; Millinder asks him back
summary: He dates the gap between Millinder and Basie and says Lucky wanted him back after his Basie solos.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: You were with Lucky Millinder in 1937 for about six months. Then, how long were you out of work before Basie…
I would say about three or four months.
So the end of ’37 you were going into Basie…
And that happened because of your association with Jo Jones and Walter Page…didn’t Lucky try and get you back?
Oh yeah, he asked me back in the band two or three times.
Was that before you were with Basie or after?
